name: The Campbell's Co.
reason: Packaged-food brand in structural decline with -3.0% 10y EPS CAGR, EPS at 0.70x its 10y peak, margin at 9th percentile, net debt/EBITDA 4.56x after the Sovos deal and private-label/GLP-1 volume pressure; no specialness.

name: Community Financial System, Inc.
reason: Conservatively run upstate NY bank with a useful benefits-admin fee business, but only 6.3% 10y EPS CAGR, 9.6% avg ROE and shares rising 2.5%/yr make it a good-but-ordinary bank rather than a special compounder.

name: Huntington Bancshares, Inc.
reason: Regional bank whose growth came from acquisitions (shares +6.3%/yr over 10y) with only 5.5% 10y EPS CAGR, 10.2% avg ROE and a -45.7% EPS year in 2020; rate/credit-cycle driven and not special.

name: HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital, Inc.
reason: Spread-dependent climate-infrastructure lender funded with leverage (net debt/EBITDA 18.3x) and equity issuance (shares +16.2%/yr), 2.4% avg ROIC, and adjusted EPS 117% above GAAP; growth is balance-sheet driven and policy-exposed.

name: Pegasystems, Inc.
reason: EBIT margin only turned positive in 2023 (10y avg 0.7%, now 16.3% at its 10y high), adjusted EPS runs 128% above GAAP, and AI-driven workflow automation could disintermediate its low-code platform, so the 5-10 year path is not forecastable.

name: Centene Corp.
reason: Government-reimbursement-dependent Medicaid/ACA insurer whose EPS fell 71% in 2025 to 0.29x its 10y peak on rate/acuity mismatches; shares +7.2%/yr from M&A and policy risk is unforecastable.

name: National Fuel Gas Co.
reason: Earnings driven by its Seneca gas E&P segment and therefore by natural-gas prices; EPS at its 10y high with margin in the 82nd percentile and FCF conversion only 0.31.

name: Century Aluminum Co.
reason: Commodity aluminum smelter with negative 10y avg ROIC (-3.8%), EPS at its 10y peak and margin at the 100th percentile after a tariff/price run-up; earnings set by aluminum and power prices.

name: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp.
reason: Labor-arbitrage IT services firm with 5.6% 10y EPS CAGR and flat ~16% margins facing a credible generative-AI threat to billable application-maintenance work within 5 years; cheap but not special.

name: Bank of Hawaii Corp.
reason: Conservative, low-cost-deposit Hawaii bank but EPS CAGR only 1.9% over 10y, EPS at 0.74x its 2021 peak and growth limited by a stagnant island economy and rate sensitivity; no route to 7%+ growth.

name: United Parks & Resorts, Inc.
reason: Regional theme-park operator with 1.9% 10y revenue CAGR, EPS 0.74x peak and declining attendance, net debt/EBITDA 4.14x after debt-funded buybacks (1.21x FCF); discretionary and not special.

name: NBT Bancorp, Inc.
reason: Steady upstate NY community bank with 8.6% 10y EPS CAGR but only 10.3% avg ROE, EPS at its 10y high, and recent growth aided by acquisitions (Salisbury, Evans); a good-but-ordinary bank without specialness.

name: CNX Resources Corp.
reason: Appalachian natural-gas producer whose earnings are set by gas prices (EBIT margin ranged -15% to 66% over 10y, now 82nd percentile) with adjusted EPS 57% below GAAP from hedge marks.

name: Stagwell, Inc.
reason: Roll-up ad agency with shares +18.2%/yr, negative avg ROIC (-1.8%), net debt/EBITDA 3.92x, a GAAP/adjusted gap that makes earnings opaque, and AI disintermediation risk to agency services.

name: Apollo Global Management, Inc.
reason: Strong 24% 10y EPS CAGR, but earnings blend Athene annuity spread income with credit/PE fees and performance fees tied to capital markets and credit cycles (EBIT margin swung -32% to 138%), making the balance sheet hard to underwrite.

name: General Mills, Inc.
reason: Mature packaged-food maker with 1.1% 10y revenue CAGR, EPS 0.79x peak and falling, margin at 9th percentile, net debt/EBITDA 4.05x, and private-label/GLP-1 volume pressure; cheap but not special.

name: Sanmina Corp.
reason: Thin-margin EMS (EBIT 4.9%, 91st percentile) mid-transformation via the 2025 ZT Systems acquisition (FY1 EPS +100%) that concentrates it on a few AI hyperscaler customers, so the 5-10 year earnings base is unforecastable.

name: Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corp.
reason: GSE-chartered secondary market for rural loans with an agency-level funding advantage, 14.9% 10y EPS CAGR with 8/10 years at 7%+ and no down year worse than -0.1%, 13.5% avg ROE and minimal credit losses; high leverage (30x) is structural for a guarantor and needs capital review.

name: Toll Brothers, Inc.
reason: Cyclical homebuilder with EPS 0.90x its 2024 peak and margin in the 82nd percentile after a sharp run-up from 8.7% (2020) to 18.7% (2024); earnings driven by mortgage rates and housing cycles.

name: Adobe, Inc.
reason: Exceptional record (26% 10y EPS CAGR, 10/10 growth years, 25.8% avg ROIC) but generative AI is a credible 5-year threat to seat-based creative software pricing and moat, reflected in a 9.0x NTM P/E, so durability cannot be forecast with confidence.
